best.text: Evidence is insufficient: none of the 8 variant runs had at least 20 closed trades and a result above break-even on this window. Don't read the comparison as a fix; it only shows how each entry style behaved here.

fixes.fix: Get more samples: use a longer window before trusting a number.
Use a nearer target (lower R:R) or a tighter, structure-based stop.
Don't enter blind at the limit: wait for lower-timeframe confirmation (a body close through the last swing in your direction) after price taps the zone.
